title: 晶体管放大电路的 CCCS 模型
statement: 图示为共射放大电路的简化模型：信号源 U_s = 2 V，R_s = 9 kΩ，R_b = 1 kΩ；电流控制电流源 F 的电流为 50·i_b（方向向下），i_b 为流过 R_b 的电流（向下）；负载 R_L = 1 kΩ。
求 i_b、输出电压 u_o（结点 o 对地）、电压增益 u_o/U_s 以及 F 吸收的功率。

questions.explain: 输入回路 U_s、R_s、R_b 串联：i_b = 2/(9k + 1k) = 0.2 mA。
F 把 50 × 0.2 = 10 mA 从结点 o 向下抽走，这个电流只能由 R_L 从地向上提供，所以 R_L 中电流（向下）为 −10 mA，u_o = 1k × (−10 mA) = −10 V。
u_o/U_s = −10/2 = −5。负号表示输出与输入反相（共射放大电路的特点）。

questions.ask: 受控源 F 吸收的功率 = ?
questions.explain: F 两端电压（上“+”下“−”）为 u_o = −10 V，电流 10 mA 从上向下，关联：P = (−10) × 0.01 = −0.1 W，F 发出 0.1 W，全部被 R_L 吸收。

hints: 受控电流源不影响输入回路，先求 i_b。
在结点 o 列 KCL：F 的 50i_b 和 R_L 的电流之和为零，注意方向带来的负号。
solution: **2. 结点 o 的 KCL。** 设 R_L 中电流 i_L 向下：i_L + 50i_b = 0 → i_L = −10 mA。
**验算：** P_RL = i_L²·R_L = 0.1 W；输入回路 U_s 发出 0.4 mW，R_s、R_b 吸收 0.36 + 0.04 = 0.4 mW。输出端的 0.1 W 来自受控源，而不是来自信号源——受控源是“放大”的能量通道。

en.title: CCCS model of a transistor amplifier
statement: The circuit is a simplified model of a common-emitter amplifier: signal source U_s = 2 V, R_s = 9 kΩ, R_b = 1 kΩ; the current-controlled current source F carries 50·i_b (downwards), where i_b is the current through R_b (downwards); load R_L = 1 kΩ.
Find i_b, the output voltage u_o (node o to ground), the voltage gain u_o/U_s and the power absorbed by F.

questions.explain: The input loop is U_s, R_s, R_b in series: i_b = 2/(9k + 1k) = 0.2 mA.
F pulls 50 × 0.2 = 10 mA down out of node o; only R_L can supply it, flowing up from ground. So the (downward) current in R_L is −10 mA and u_o = 1k × (−10 mA) = −10 V.
u_o/U_s = −10/2 = −5. The minus sign means the output is inverted, typical of a common-emitter stage.
The voltage across F (+ at the top) is u_o = −10 V and its 10 mA flows downwards (passive convention): P = (−10) × 0.01 = −0.1 W. F delivers 0.1 W, all absorbed by R_L.

hints: The dependent current source does not affect the input loop: find i_b first.
Write KCL at node o: the 50i_b of F and the current in R_L add up to zero — watch the sign that comes from the directions.
solution: **1. Input loop.** **i_b = U_s/(R_s + R_b) = 2 V/10 kΩ = 0.2 mA**.
**2. KCL at node o.** Let i_L be the downward current in R_L: i_L + 50i_b = 0 → i_L = −10 mA.
**4. Power of F.** u_F = u_o = −10 V (+ at the top), 10 mA downwards (passive convention): **P_F = −10 × 0.01 = −0.1 W**.

**Check:** P_RL = i_L²·R_L = 0.1 W; in the input loop U_s delivers 0.4 mW and R_s, R_b absorb 0.36 + 0.04 = 0.4 mW. The 0.1 W at the output comes from the dependent source, not from the signal source — the dependent source is the energy path of the "amplification".
